first degree recklessly endangering safety, use of a dangerous weapon, possession of a firearm by a
felon, and armed burglary. And he remains in custody currently. His initial plea of not guilty
was entered in September, and his next court date is set for early November of 2003. He maintains that
he wasn't shooting at police, though gave no clear alternative explanation for his actions.
He also didn't have an explanation for his obsession with addicts.
